name: auto-ai-setup
description: Local, consent-driven AI agent project setup CLI

scripts.test:integration: pnpm exec vitest run tests/cli-session.test.ts tests/transaction-engine.test.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:property
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.ci: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:property && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run build && pnpm run pack && pnpm run smoke
